fact: The revised Cybercrimes Act, Cap. 443 (R.E. 2023), as printed by the Government of Tanzania in 2025, states it commenced on 1 September 2015 and applies to Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, with offences, search and seizure and critical information infrastructure provisions.
title: The Cybercrimes Act, Cap. 443 [R.E. 2023]
publisher: Government of Tanzania, Office of the Attorney General
